card.name: Digits inside dates and phone numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit, often 0, right after a separator or leading zero inside a date, phone number, ISBN or ID code. It responds to the digit itself, not to ordinary numbers in prose.

modes.label: Dates
modes.description: A zero digit within a day or month in a dotted or slashed date.

modes.label: Phone numbers
modes.description: A digit right after an opening 0 or area-code bracket in a phone number.

modes.label: Codes and IDs
modes.description: A digit inside an ISBN, postcode extension or student ID.

card.plain: It lights up on a digit inside a date, phone number or ID code, where more digits follow.
